flaws.text: D1 requires every landing of a slice (a slice can land twice; slices 172, 305 and 940 each have two merges on first-parent history), but D2 resolves them by reusing `_search_merge_commit` with a `first_parent` flag. At `90725f6d` that helper runs `git log --merges ... -1` and returns only the newest merge, as `str | None` (`review/git_utils.py:221-243`). It cannot return multiple landings. The correction stops reusing it and has the resolver run `git log --first-parent` itself, sharing only the pattern and parse functions. **VALID**: contradicts code.
